text: a golden fruit fell from the heavens.
But it could not be shared.
Kartikeya, the swift, and Ganesha, the wise.
Whoever circles the whole world three times first, wins the fruit.
Kartikeya leapt onto his peacock, and was gone in a flash.
Ganesha looked at his little mouse. And smiled.
Over oceans. Over mountains. Across every land.
Ganesha simply walked around his parents.
When Kartikeya returned, the race was already won.
That is why they say, the world is not out there.
It is the ones who made you.
